collect_comments_description: Collect the video, then read the comment drawer page by page: nickname, text, time and IP region, expanding long comments and replies, and visit commenter profiles up to the limit to get Channels IDs. Page, reply and profile limits are task options; tick Unlimited to collect until the end of the comments. Local storage only; upload is deferred.
project_description: Compose WeChat Channels operations in order: open profiles and videos, like, and return. Add, remove and drag tasks to reorder them. Keep the phone unlocked, awake and in portrait, and use foreground mode.
task_name: Like current video → author profile → personal page
task_description: Start on WeChat main, Discover, Channels recommendations, or the personal page. Like once only if unliked. After finding the red thumb, recognize the author name to its left, visit the author profile, return to the feed, and open the personal page. Stop on recognition failure. Keep the phone unlocked, awake and in portrait. Changed layouts or icons require new samples.
open_wechat_description: Launch WeChat; then add Open Discover.
open_discover_description: Use the WeChat navigation bar and confirm the Channels entry.
open_channels_description: Open Channels from Discover and confirm the recommendations page.
open_author_description: Open the current video author from recommendations or video detail; liking is optional.
open_author_video_description: Open the first recognizable video card on an author profile. Locate its small thumb badge; stop if none is found.
like_video_description: Works on recommendations and video detail. Skip when already liked; otherwise tap once and verify the red state.
return_to_author_description: Return from a profile video to its author and verify the follow and contact controls.
return_to_feed_description: Return from an author opened via recommendations to the recommendations page.
open_personal_description: Open the personal page from recommendations; supports combined and split row layouts.
profile_video_like_description: Open the current author, open the first recognizable video, and like once if needed. You can also add and reorder the individual operations.
preset_compose_description: Add, remove and drag operations after creation. Enable Stop remaining tasks on failure in Settings.
collect_task_description: Open recommendations and collect the author, full description, publication label and location. Read the author's bio, certification, IP location and public Channels ID. Keep this run's first nickname and first complete description, then return and save a deduplicated local draft without reading or comparing them again. Log each step in milliseconds. Fields not displayed remain null. Server upload is not configured.
interact_work_name: Interact with the current video (batch actions)
interact_work_description: Performs the actions selected below on the current video in the Channels recommended feed: like, recommend/favourite, post a comment, like or reply to a comment, follow and like/favourite the first work on the author's or a commenter's profile, and inspect Channels message notifications. Opens the recommended feed from WeChat first when it is not on screen, in which case the action may land on a different video. Already liked, favourited or followed states are never clicked again; repeated comments and replies are skipped; own comments are never replied to. Daily quotas apply across restarts (likes 50, recommends 30, comments 20, follows 20). Direct messages are not sent. The task fails without touching the phone when no action is selected or a comment action has no target comment.
interact_work_actions_description: Performed on the current video. Select any.
interact_comment_actions_description: Pages through the current video's comments (up to 10 pages) to find the target comment and does nothing when it is not found.
interact_target_comment_description: Fill in the nickname, the content or both; when both are given both must match. Content matches by substring, so a distinctive excerpt is enough.
interact_profile_actions_description: Follow is skipped when the profile already shows Following; first-work actions are skipped when the profile has no videos. Users without a Channels account are only recorded as visited.
interact_case_like_first: Like the first video on the profile
interact_case_collect_first: Recommend / favourite the first video on the profile
interact_author_profile_description: Opens the current video's author profile, performs the actions below and returns to the feed.
interact_messages_description: Opens Channels messages → Comments from the personal page, handles notifications not handled before and returns to the feed.
interact_messages_reply_description: Leave empty to like without replying.
interact_self_nickname_description: Identifies your own comments so you never reply to yourself. Detected from the comment section when left empty.
collect_comments_unlimited_description: Ignores the three limits below: pages to the end of the comments, expands every reply thread and visits every commenter. Slow on videos with many comments.
collect_comments_limits_description: Used when Unlimited is not ticked. Pages must be at least 1; 0 replies or profiles skips that step.
